title: AI Insider: The Fastest Way To Use AI Agents In Your Business, Content & Life (Open Claw & Claude)
summary: Allie K. Miller, a longtime AI educator, joins Calum Johnson to argue that non-technical people are outpacing engineers with AI by treating it as an operating system rather than a tool. She walks through the shift from ChatGPT-style assistants to action-taking agents like Claude Code and Claude Cowork, sharing concrete examples — including a friend whose agent hired a handyman off Nextdoor to fix her cables for $30 in under 12 hours. She demonstrates how she runs her entire content operation through a custom Claude Code app called 'voice to social' that fans out one idea into nine platform-specific artifacts, and gives a 4.5-minute onboarding path to Claude Cowork for beginners. The throughline: stop going tool-first, go problem-first, and use progressive trust when granting agents access to your systems.
